comment: Rule set captures. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE and FRAGR_QA_MUTATORS set on the tour server. The frame is evidence only if the chip names the rules the server was started with.

states.name: modes_follow
states.note: Spectator chase view: mode chip, side score, team-coloured fighters and nameplates, the followed side.

states.name: modes_overview
states.note: Both sides on the map in their colours.

states.name: modes_body_coalition_human
states.note: Free coalition side: a human body keeps its own free palette under the side plate. Requires FRAGR_QA_MODE=tdm.

states.name: modes_body_coalition_synthetic
states.note: Free coalition side: a synthetic body keeps bone, leather, ember and cyan, never Union black and red.

states.name: modes_body_union_side
states.note: The Union side of a team match: the same body under the dark side tint and red plate, so sides still read apart.

states.name: modes_first_person
states.note: A joined player sees the same chip and the side score.
